$jsonSchema.title: Notifications Schema - OWASP Compliant
$jsonSchema.description: A notification delivered or pending delivery to a user across one or more channels (com.pml.identity.domain.model.Notification)

_class.description: Spring Data MongoDB's type hint. Written on every document by the mapping converter, so a validator with additionalProperties:false that omits it rejects every write the application makes — silently in tests, which use a template with no validator, and totally in production.

_id.description: notify:{deduplicationKey}, so a redelivered request finds the notification it already wrote

userId.description: The recipient's account; absent when the subject names the destination, as for a team invitation

data.description: Additional structured data, e.g. ticketId, eventId
